title: Hour of the Olympics
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie cheer at the first Olympics and ride the winged horse Pegasus! 杰克和安妮在古代奥运会呐喊助威，还骑上了长翅膀的飞马珀伽索斯！

q.en: Which research book does Morgan give Jack and Annie for their trip to ancient Greece?
q.zh: 摩根为这次古希腊之旅，给了杰克和安妮哪一本参考书？

options.en: The Story of the Olympic Games

explain.en: Morgan hands them a book titled A Day in Ancient Greece, which shows the Olympic festival at Olympia and the red-brick buildings with columns.
explain.zh: 摩根交给他们一本《古希腊的一天》，书里展现了奥林匹亚的奥运盛会和有柱子的红砖建筑。

q.en: Who is the bearded philosopher that helps Jack and Annie find the secret poet?
q.zh: 那位留着白胡须、帮助他们找到神秘女诗人的哲学家是谁？

explain.en: A man with a short white beard introduces himself as Plato, a philosopher who is a "lover of wisdom" and a friend of the secret poet.
explain.zh: 一位留着白短须的男子自我介绍叫柏拉图，是一位“爱好智慧”的哲学家，也是那位神秘女诗人的朋友。

q.en: In ancient Greece, which of these things was a girl NOT allowed to do?
q.zh: 在古希腊，下面哪一件事是女孩子不被允许做的？

options.en: go to school or attend the Olympics
walk freely in the crowded marketplace
options.zh: 在拥挤的集市上随意走动

explain.en: Jack reads that girls were not allowed to go to school, women could not act in plays, and a girl would get in terrible trouble if she attended the Olympics.
explain.zh: 杰克读到，女孩子不能上学，妇女不能登台演戏，女孩子如果去看奥运会会惹上大麻烦。

q.en: The young woman who wrote the poem does not give her real name. How does she sign it?
q.zh: 写这首诗的年轻女子没有说出真名。她是怎么署名的？

options.en: with the name of her older brother

explain.en: The poet says she cannot give her name and tells Annie she can say it was written by Anonymous, because the risk of being found out is too great.
explain.zh: 女诗人说不能透露名字，并告诉安妮可以说这是“Anonymous（匿名）”写的，因为被发现的代价太大了。

q.en: What is the sacred tree of the Greeks, whose branches are made into the winners' crowns?
q.zh: 希腊人的圣树是什么？获胜者头上的花冠就是用它的树枝编成的。

explain.en: Plato says the olive tree is the sacred tree of the Greeks, and the winners of the games wear crowns made from its branches.
explain.zh: 柏拉图说橄榄树是希腊人的圣树，运动会的获胜者头戴用橄榄枝编成的花冠。

q.en: The Olympic Games are played in honor of which chief Greek god?
q.zh: 奥林匹克运动会是为了敬奉哪位希腊主神而举办的？

explain.en: Inside the Temple of Zeus stands a huge statue of Zeus, the chief god. The Olympic Games are played in his honor and athletes swore to him.
explain.zh: 宙斯神庙里立着宙斯的巨型雕像，他是众神之主。奥运会正是为他而办，运动员还向他发誓。

q.en: On the very first day of the games, what event is held — the greatest honor to win?
q.zh: 在运动会的第一天举行的是什么项目——也是最高荣誉的赛事？

explain.en: Plato tells Jack the first day is the day of the chariot races, and winning a chariot race is the greatest honor of the games.
explain.zh: 柏拉图告诉杰克，第一天是战车赛的日子，而赢得战车赛是运动会最高的荣誉。

q.en: In the Olympic chariot race, how many horses pull each chariot?
q.zh: 在奥林匹克战车比赛中，每辆战车由几匹马牵引？

explain.en: Jack sees dozens of chariots lined up on the track, and each chariot is pulled by four horses as the race begins.
explain.zh: 杰克看到赛道上排着几十辆战车，每辆战车都由四匹马牵引，比赛随即开始。

q.en: What great winged horse appears and carries Jack and Annie to safety in his chariot?
q.zh: 是哪匹长着翅膀的巨马出现，用战车把杰克和安妮带到了安全的地方？

explain.en: A huge white horse pulls an empty chariot to them, then grows giant feathery wings and flies them to the olive grove. Morgan names him Pegasus.
explain.zh: 一匹白色巨马拉着空战车来到他们面前，随后长出巨大羽翼，载他们飞到橄榄树林。摩根号称他为珀伽索斯。

q.en: Morgan says the poet signed her story "Anonymous." What does that word mean?
q.zh: 摩根说女诗人署名“Anonymous”。这个词是什么意思？

options.en: the wise queen of all Greece
no one knows who wrote it

explain.en: Plato explains that "anonymous" means that no one knows who wrote it. Morgan adds that many talented women used that name in the past.
explain.zh: 柏拉图解释，“anonymous”意思就是没人知道是谁写的。摩根补充说，过去许多有才华的女性都用了这个名字。
